title: A disabled action's `disabledReason` tooltip has no max width: on a phone-width viewport the reason runs off-screen
body:
Found by the hotclm app (objectstack-ai/hotclm#195, PR #200) on `@objectstack/*` 18.3.0.

**What happens.** A declared action that is `disabled` shows its authored `disabledReason` in a tooltip. In the Console record page at a 390px viewport (hotclm contract ICA-2026-0004, signed in as a legal counsel), the greyed 送审 / Send for Approval tooltip renders 727px wide on one line, so it runs off the right edge. The English reason is cut after '…no deviation may'. At 1024px and 1400px it fits.

**Seam.** `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/DeclaredActionsBar.tsx` L737 renders `<TooltipContent>{disabledReason}</TooltipContent>` with no width bound. The disabled-reason tooltip on the home page (`HomePage.tsx`) uses `max-w-xs` and wraps.

**Expected.** The action-bar tooltip wraps within the viewport like the home page's, so an authored reason (18.3's `disabledReason`, ActionSchema) is readable on a phone.

Dedupe: no open issue mentions this tooltip or `disabledReason` wrapping.
